addition.item: Added src/Helper/UkSlidePortfolio2Helper.php with modern helper structure
Now fully compatible with Joomla 5.x and 6.x WITHOUT compatibility plugin
Automatic Modal ID generation (based on module ID and item index)
Added "Card Class" parameter (custom CSS classes for cards)

change.item: Migrated to Joomla 5/6 architecture with namespaces
Updated XML manifest with namespace declaration
Changed "Content" field from textarea to editor (full WYSIWYG support)

fix.item: Fixed: Modal IDs are now always unique, even with multiple module instances

remove.item: Removed manual "modal_link" field from form (no longer needed)
Removed Modal ID info note from form (cleaner interface)

note.item: Changelog metadata update (2026-11-06): Release notes are now maintained as XML and published centrally at https://github.com/joomlaplates-de/changelogs. This package includes its release snapshot as changelog.xml.

fix.item: Changes Prefix. All modules have now the "JP"-Module Name
Ready for J5 and J6 without compatibility Plugin (claimed, but not implemented)

remove.item: Removed the XML version. Not needed anymore for J5 or J6
